lifecycle.stopped: A nonzero engine pointer followed by zero means the engine was destroyed. Hide and stop the isolated player, flush saves, then remove its iframe.

viewport.note: Window IDs change when the renderer recreates its SDL window; never assume ID 1.

configuredLinkFlags: -s INITIAL_MEMORY=128MB -s STACK_SIZE=32MB -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s FORCE_FILESYSTEM -lidbfs.js -s ASYNCIFY=1 -s ASYNCIFY_STACK_SIZE=1048576 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS=[_main,_malloc,_free,_raise] -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=[ccall,lengthBytesUTF8,setValue,writeArrayToMemory] --js-library backends/networking/http/emscripten/networkreadstream-emscripten.js -O2 --pre-js $(srcdir)/dists/emscripten/custom_shell-pre.js --post-js $(srcdir)/dists/emscripten/custom_shell-post.js --shell-file $(srcdir)/dists/emscripten/custom_shell.html
linkerOverrides:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
include Makefile

# Upstream's JS library path assumes an in-tree build.
LDFLAGS := $(subst --js-library backends/,--js-library $(srcdir)/backends/,$(LDFLAGS))
# The external launcher supplies arguments; Neverhood does not need Web MIDI.
LDFLAGS := $(subst --pre-js $(srcdir)/dists/emscripten/custom_shell-pre.js,,$(LDFLAGS))
# Keep upstream's exports and expose the filesystem to the external launcher.
LDFLAGS += -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=[ccall,lengthBytesUTF8,setValue,writeArrayToMemory,FS,IDBFS,callMain,getValue]
# Observe the existing engine pointer without changing upstream source.
LDFLAGS += -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS=[_main,_malloc,_free,_raise,_g_engine,_SDL_GetWindowFromID,_SDL_GetWindowID,_SDL_GL_GetCurrentWindow,_SDL_GetKeyboardFocus,_SDL_SetWindowSize,_emscripten_pause_main_loop]
LDFLAGS += -s EXIT_RUNTIME=1

$(EXECUTABLE): .EXTRA_PREREQS := $(firstword $(MAKEFILE_LIST))
sourceCompliance: Before public binary distribution provide corresponding ScummVM, SDL and toolchain library source and build scripts as required by their licenses. A revision URL alone is not a complete GPL source offer.
